ANTHROPIC_GRAY = RgbColor(128, 128, 128)   # Gray for secondary text

# Read the Q1 data

p.text = data['slides'][1]['content']
p.font.size = Pt(28)
p.font.color.rgb = ANTHROPIC_DARK

# Slide 4: Next Steps

# Title

p.text = data['slides'][2]['content']

output_path = '/workspace/Q1_Results_Q4_2024.pptx'

print(f"Presentation saved to: {output_path}")
